thread:
mei: Quick heads-up: onboarding nova-lite-v3 int8 on staging. Small smoke shows zh->en and ja->en BLEU dips vs fp16 and a couple detok/tokenize oddities. Notably: narrow no-break space (U+202F) preserved between RTL token and '(' and occasional ZWSP (U+200B) inserted between CJK+kana that shifts merges. Repro and notes below.

arnaud: Can you paste the minimal repro + tokenizer dump?

mei: Repro I ran:
```
# samples.txt
zh: \u6d77\u5916\u306b\u884c\u304f\u3002
ja: \u3053\u3093\u306b\u3061\u306f\u3002
mix: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645(\u05e9\u05dc\u05d5\u05dd)"
# tokenize-only with artifact
python infra/eval/run_eval.py --artifact /artifacts/nova-lite-v3/int8 --tokenize-only --input samples.txt --out tok.txt
```

mei: tok.txt excerpt: "\u6d77\u5916" "\u306b" "\u884c" "\u304f" "\u3002"
"\u3053\u3093\u306b\u3061\u306f" "\u3002"
"\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645" "\\u202F(" "\u05e9\u05dc\u05d5\u05dd" ")"

ken: That literal \\u202F between RTL and '(' is suspicious. Is fp16 canonicalizing away U+202F?

zhen: I ran a quick dev eval: fp16 BLEU=32.0, int8 artifact BLEU=28.6 (same config). If I run the int8 model but override the tokenizer to use fp16 tokenizer files BLEU=31.8. So main regression seems tokenization/detok related.

arnaud: Which packager/builder produced the int8 artifact? Any packager version bump?

mei: int8 build id int8-20260814-09, builder=packager-8. fp16 was built with packager-6. Packager changelog says "preserve narrow spaces by default in mixed-direction blocks" between 6->8.

ken: That could explain U+202F preservation. Also check packaging env flags like PRESERVE_BIDI. If that changed, detok might be running a bidi reorder that changes stored order.

mei: Good call. fp16 artifact had PRESERVE_BIDI=true; int8 packager default uses PRESERVE_BIDI=false. Grep shows detok calls unicode_bidi_reorder() when preserve_bidi=false. That can mutate stored ordering (not just rendering).

ci-bot: Created issue ML-4021 "nova-lite-v3 int8 tokenizer/detok parity -> BLEU regression" with labels triage, tokenizer, quant.

arnaud: Quick triage summary: two independent packaging diffs: 1) normalizer rules changed (U+202F/U+200B handling) because packager default changed; 2) PRESERVE_BIDI env default flipped causing detok bidi reorder. Combined they cause token splits + bracket mirroring -> BLEU drop.

ken: Proposed mitigations: 1) rebuild int8 artifact with fp16 normalizer (map U+202F->space, drop ZWSP between CJK/kana), 2) set PRESERVE_BIDI=true in packager env for quant builds, 3) add artifact CI lint: tokenizer_inspect --dump normalizer and fail on unexpected diffs vs a whitelist, 4) add a micro mixedscript eval gate (small ja/zh + RTL bracket samples) to catch BLEU regressions >0.5.

mei: I patched the int8 artifact locally by copying fp16 normalizer.json into int8 bundle and flipping PRESERVE_BIDI=true then re-ran a 1k-sent ja-en dev subset. Results: fp16 BLEU=33.5, patched-int8 BLEU=33.2 (good recovery). Also the paren flip sample now has stable stored ordering, no mirrored paren.

arnaud: Great. Longer-term we should: pin packager behaviour in our infra, add release note for tokenizer maintainers about U+200B/U+202F handling, and enforce a tokenizer parity smoke in artifact CI.

packer-bot: Noted. Opening infra-packager follow-up ticket PKG-189 to revert risky defaults and add config knobs.

ken: Also add a unit in tokenizer-inspect that runs a tiny mixedscript list and asserts no insertion of ZWSP or preservation of narrow NBSP where we expect canonicalization. That will catch future packager upgrades.

mei: I'll roll the patched int8 artifact to staging and run full e2e smoke. ETA ~40m. Will update ML-4021 with final numbers. Thanks for quick help :thumbsup:

zhen: If you want me to run kernel parity checks after that, ping me.

ci-bot: ML-4021 labels updated: needs-fix, blocker-for-int8-onboard.
